about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Finnian — 陈祺宏, Qihong Chen — a developer in Dongguan, China. The name is Old Irish for light, spirit and clarity; I keep it because it reads easier than a pinyin nobody spells right.
about.p2: I spent years making pixels behave — interfaces, motion, the small delights that make a page feel alive. Then I met large language models and never looked back. Now I build AI applications: agents that plan, retrieve and act — still wrapped in interfaces that feel considered.
about.p3: Away from the screen I train calisthenics, live in music, and take photographs of things before they move.
about.aside: currently: learning agent orchestration · drinking too much coffee · live in the moment · petting the cat

dsh.title: dsh-sight
dsh.desc: Plug-in vision for a text-only DeepSeek agent harness: built-in free and low-cost VLM presets, plus multi-image batch analysis.

researcher.title: Mini Deep Researcher
researcher.desc: A LangChain LCEL pipeline that turns one vague topic into a cited long-form report: outline planning, multi-source search, fact extraction, synthesis.

bid.title: Bid Review System
bid.desc: Intelligent review of bid documents — automated compliance checking and risk assessment. I built the interface for a piece of reasoning that had none.

skills.title: Skills
skills.aside: prompt design, tool / function calling and evals — the parts nobody put on a logo.

contact.title: Contact
contact.p: The cat checks the mailbox twice a day. So do I. Write to me about agents, interfaces, a role you think fits — or just to say hi.
